status: project-authored teaching model; not clinically calibrated
decayArithmetic: 1us trapezoidal Q62 repeated squaring; fractional interpolation
recurrence: Q32 base and age-weighted tails advance on an epoch-relative source-time 8ms grid; exact pulse joins split steps; ties-to-even at every transition
reconstruction: Bounded historical tails rebuild every source-time second; queries between grid points advance only the remainder from the preceding canonical state
cache: Four immutable one-second blocks; derived cache is excluded from checkpoints and cannot affect output
compatibility: Explicit @1 plans reject; @2 changes Q32 rounding while preserving timing and smooth runoff
limitations: No optical DC, device filter or automatic gain model
Tau and shape are authored; not HED implementation
Eventually quantizes to baseline without new ejection
